about: Objects and animals of Creepyville, painted once and reused in every story. h = height in pixels when standing next to the hero (he is about 620 px tall).

black_cat.prompt: a sleek black cat sitting upright, glowing yellow eyes, tail curled

dog.prompt: a friendly scruffy brown dog sitting, floppy ears, red collar

traffic_cone.prompt: an orange traffic cone with white stripes

old_tv.prompt: an old boxy television on short legs, screen glowing with static

goose.prompt: A plump, aggressively confident white goose with an orange bill and unblinking beady eyes that radiates unwarranted menace.

garden_gnome.prompt: A chipped ceramic garden gnome with a pointy red cap, a curly white beard, and an unsettlingly smug grin that seems to shift when nobody is looking.

possum.prompt: A scruffy, round-eyed opossum frozen completely stiff in a comical, overly dramatic 'playing dead' pose.

vending_machine.prompt: A humming retro snack vending machine casting a sickly green fluorescent glow, filled with suspiciously mysterious glowing soda cans.

dog_standing.prompt: the same friendly scruffy brown dog with floppy ears and a red collar, standing upright on its two hind legs like a person, front paws hanging down, eerie still pose, full body

bat.prompt: A cute yet slightly spooky black bat hanging upside down with big glossy eyes and small folded wings.

lava_lamp.prompt: A retro glass lava lamp emitting a soft eerie neon-green glow around swirling blobs of dark orange wax.

gargoyle.prompt: A small mossy stone gargoyle statue sitting crouched with a surprisingly goofy, wide-eyed expression.

skunk.prompt: A mischievous black-and-white skunk standing alertly with a puffed tail and glowing yellow eyes.

chihuahua.prompt: A tiny, shivering brown chihuahua with bulging eyes and a hilarious, perpetually suspicious expression.

gumball_machine.prompt: A classic red metal gumball machine on a stand, filled with colorful round candies decorated like tiny staring eyeballs.

tricycle.prompt: A rusted vintage red metal tricycle with squeaky rubber tires and faded handlebar streamers that inexplicably turns up in empty hallways.

plastic_flamingo.prompt: A weathered neon-pink lawn flamingo mounted on thin wire legs with chipped paint and comically suspicious, unblinking black eyes.

mannequin.prompt: A pale, featureless fiberglass retail mannequin standing rigidly on a chrome circular stand, dressed in a slightly ill-fitting retro suit jacket.

pigeon.prompt: A plump gray city pigeon with iridescent neck feathers and wide unblinking round eyes that stares forward with an unsettlingly blank expression.

haunted_cuckoo_clock.prompt: An ornate carved wooden cuckoo clock with a tiny glowing skeletal bird popping out of its door.

ferret.prompt: A mischievous black ferret wearing a miniature purple cape and sporting bright yellow glowing eyes.

sphynx_cat.prompt: A completely hairless, wrinkly pink sphynx cat wearing a slightly oversized striped sweater, glaring forward with an unimpressed and suspicious expression.

jack_in_the_box.prompt: A vintage metal wind-up toy box with faded circus decals and a popped-open lid revealing a wide-eyed, goofy-grinning jester puppet on a coiled spring.

robot_vacuum.prompt: A small circular robotic vacuum cleaner creeping along the floor with a glowing red sensor light and two plastic googly eyes taped to its bumper.

pelican.prompt: An unblinking, scruffy pelican standing bolt upright with a deadpan expression and an unnervingly lumpy throat pouch.

corgi.prompt: A stubby, cheerful corgi with unnaturally glowing yellow eyes and a permanent goofy grin.

haunted_toaster.prompt: A vintage shiny chrome toaster equipped with tiny bat-wing handles that occasionally sparks and pops out charred toast.

hairless_guinea_pig.prompt: A tiny wrinkled pink hairless guinea pig with oversized twitching ears and an unnaturally intense blank stare.

creepy_nutcracker.prompt: A vintage wooden nutcracker soldier with unnaturally wide staring glass eyes and a broad toothy grimace.

ventriloquist_dummy.prompt: A creepy vintage ventriloquist dummy wearing a tiny tuxedo, with glossy wooden cheeks and wide, glassy unblinking eyes.

chameleon.prompt: A plump, bright green chameleon sitting awkwardly on its hind legs with mismatched wall-eyed pupils staring in two different directions.

singing_wall_fish.prompt: A mounted taxidermy animatronic bass on a wooden plaque with eerie glowing yellow eyes and a slightly open mouth.

capybara.prompt: A completely stoic, unbothered brown capybara wearing a tiny white bedsheet ghost costume with cutout eye holes.

screaming_rubber_chicken.prompt: A bright yellow rubber chicken with wide startled eyes and an open beak perpetually frozen in a silent squawk.

fuzzy_alpaca.prompt: A fluff-heavy alpaca with an unnervingly intense, unblinking stare and a stylishly side-swept hair tuft.

possessed_rocking_horse.prompt: A worn vintage wooden rocking horse with chipped red paint, an eerie carved grin, and glowing yellow marble eyes.

creepy_sloth.prompt: A shaggy brown sloth with slow deliberate movements, an unblinking wide-eyed stare, and a mysteriously permanent smirking expression.

shoebill_stork.prompt: A tall, completely motionless shoebill stork with slate-grey plumage, pale unblinking eyes, and an enormous wooden-looking clacking bill.

cymbal_banging_monkey.prompt: A retro mechanical wind-up monkey in a faded red vest, featuring bulging glassy eyes, an unsettling toothy grimace, and two tarnished brass cymbals poised to strike.
